## CVE-2026-96940

Microsoft Exchange Server contains a vulnerability due to weak authorization that allows an authenticated attacker to elevate their privileges over the network.

Affected products:
- Exchange Server

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-96940

## CVE-2026-69435

CVE-2026-69435 is a vulnerability in the Microsoft Azure SRE Agent caused by missing authorization checks. This flaw allows an authenticated attacker to perform unauthorized actions and escalate privileges over the network.

Affected products:
- Azure SRE Agent

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-69435

## CVE-2026-77900

A vulnerability in Microsoft Azure App Service allows an unauthorized remote attacker to execute arbitrary code due to missing authentication for a critical function. This flaw carries a high CVSS base score of 9.8 and facilitates RCE over a network without requiring prior authentication.

Affected products:
- Azure App Service

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-77900

## CVE-2026-88131

CVE-2026-88131 is a critical vulnerability in Microsoft Dataverse involving insecure deserialization of untrusted data, which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to achieve remote code execution (RCE) over a network.

Affected products:
- Dataverse

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-88131

## CVE-2026-94510

Microsoft Bookings contains an authorization bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-94510) caused by a user-controlled key, which allows an unauthenticated attacker to perform privilege escalation over a network. The vulnerability carries a high CVSS base score of 9.9, indicating critical severity.

Affected products:
- Bookings

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-94510

## CVE-2026-96207

CVE-2026-96207 describes a vulnerability in Microsoft Partner Center involving improper certificate validation. This flaw allows an unauthorized, network-adjacent attacker to perform privilege escalation within the platform.

Affected products:
- Partner Center

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-96207

## CVE-2026-83943

CVE-2026-83943 is an information exposure vulnerability in Microsoft Azure API Center that allows an unauthorized attacker to access sensitive information over a network. The vulnerability has a CVSS v3.1 base score of 8.7, indicating a high risk of unauthorized data disclosure.

Affected products:
- Azure API Center

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-83943

## CVE-2026-83947

CVE-2026-83947 describes a missing authorization vulnerability in Azure Event Grid. This flaw allows an authenticated attacker to perform spoofing attacks over a network, potentially leading to unauthorized data handling or service manipulation within the event-driven architecture.

Affected products:
- Azure Event Grid

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-83947

## CVE-2026-108744

The pbi-cli tool is vulnerable to OS command injection due to the improper handling of .pbip file paths within the desktop_sync.py module. When reopening projects, the application passes unquoted file paths to 'cmd /c start', allowing an attacker to execute arbitrary commands by crafting a malicious path containing shell metacharacters such as '&'. This vulnerability results in command execution with the privileges of the user running the application.

Affected products:
- pbi-cli (3.10.1 through 3.12.0)

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-108744

## CVE-2026-100202

A use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows Message Queuing (MSMQ) Queue Manager allows a remote, unauthorized attacker to achieve remote code execution over a network. This critical vulnerability poses a high risk as it can be exploited without authentication.

Affected products:
- Windows Message Queuing Queue Manager

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-100202

## CVE-2026-100219

CVE-2026-100219 describes a use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft QUIC. The flaw allows a remote, unauthorized attacker to trigger arbitrary code execution over a network with a CVSS v3.1 base score of 9.8, indicating critical severity.

Affected products:
- Microsoft QUIC

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-100219

- Office Access

## CVE-2026-105718

CVE-2026-105718 describes an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Microsoft Excel that can be leveraged by a remote unauthorized attacker to achieve remote code execution over a network. - Excel

- Dynamics Business Central

CVE-2026-108135 is a local privilege escalation vulnerability in the Windows Backup Engine caused by improper link resolution before file access. An authorized local attacker can exploit this flaw to gain higher privileges by leveraging the 'link following' vulnerability during the backup process.

Affected products:
- Windows Backup Engine

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-108135

- Windows Codecs Library

- Windows PDF

- SysInternals

## CVE-2026-69963

A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Microsoft Streaming Service driver allows a local, authorized attacker to escalate privileges. Detection should focus on monitoring for abnormal process behavior or unexpected kernel-mode activity originating from the streaming service driver.

Affected products:
- Streaming Service

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69963

## CVE-2026-69967

CVE-2026-69967 is an information disclosure vulnerability residing in the Windows Overlay Filter component. The flaw is caused by an out-of-bounds read, which could allow an authorized local attacker to read sensitive information that should otherwise be restricted.

Affected products:
- Windows Overlay Filter

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69967

## CVE-2026-69966

CVE-2026-69966 is a local privilege escalation vulnerability in the Microsoft Kernel Streaming Service caused by an integer overflow or wraparound condition, allowing an authenticated attacker to gain higher privileges on the target system.

Affected products:
- Kernel Streaming Service

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69966

## CVE-2026-69964

A use-after-free vulnerability exists in the Microsoft Kernel Streaming Service driver, which can be exploited by a local, authorized attacker to achieve privilege escalation.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69964

- Streaming Service

- Windows

A use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft Windows Cryptographic Services allows an authorized attacker to achieve remote code execution over a network. This flaw represents a critical security risk to the integrity and availability of Windows systems, requiring immediate patching as identified by Microsoft Security Response Center.

Affected products:
- Windows Cryptographic Services

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70014

- Windows Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS)

## CVE-2026-70033

CVE-2026-70033 is a denial of service vulnerability in the Windows Remote Desktop Gateway (RD Gateway) service. The issue stems from a failure to properly release memory after its effective lifetime, which can be triggered by an unauthorized attacker over a network to cause the service to crash or become unavailable.

Affected products:
- Windows Remote Desktop Gateway

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70033

## CVE-2026-70056

- Windows Update Service

## CVE-2026-70076

CVE-2026-70076 describes a use-after-free vulnerability within the Windows Win32k kernel subsystem. This flaw allows an attacker who has already gained initial authorization on a system to execute arbitrary code or perform operations with elevated privileges, effectively escalating their access rights on the local machine.

Affected products:
- Windows

- DNS Server

Affected products:
- DNS Server

## CVE-2026-70117

A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows Win32k kernel subsystem allows a local, authorized attacker to elevate their privileges to higher system levels. Exploitation of this vulnerability involves memory corruption in the kernel, potentially granting unauthorized access or control over the affected system.

Affected products:
- Windows

## CVE-2026-70127

CVE-2026-70127 is a use-after-free vulnerability in the Microsoft Windows Domain Name Service (DNS) that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. The vulnerability exists due to improper memory management, and exploitation can be achieved by sending a specially crafted request to a vulnerable DNS server.

Affected products:
- Windows Domain Name Service

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70127

## CVE-2026-70123

CVE-2026-70123 is a local privilege escalation vulnerability in the Microsoft Graphics Component caused by a numeric truncation error. An authorized attacker could exploit this vulnerability to gain higher privileges on the host system.

Affected products:
- Graphics Component

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70123

## CVE-2026-70140

CVE-2026-70140 describes a use-after-free vulnerability within the Windows Audio Service that allows a local, authorized attacker to elevate their privileges to that of the service, potentially gaining administrative control over the system.

CVE-2026-70225 is a type confusion vulnerability in the Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock (afdsys.sys) that allows a locally authenticated attacker to escalate privileges. - Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock

## CVE-2026-70255

CVE-2026-70255 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows Desktop Window Manager that enables a locally authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. Detection should focus on monitoring for unauthorized attempts to access or manipulate DWM processes or system-level handles by unprivileged users.

Affected products:
- Desktop Window Manager

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70255

## CVE-2026-70580

CVE-2026-70580 is a security vulnerability in Windows Credential Guard caused by missing authentication for a critical function. This flaw allows a locally authorized attacker to successfully perform spoofing, potentially compromising the integrity of credential protection mechanisms.

Affected products:
- Windows Credential Guard

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70580

## CVE-2026-69354

CVE-2026-69354 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows Error Reporting component that allows a locally authenticated attacker to escalate privileges on the affected system.

Affected products:
- Windows Error Reporting

## CVE-2026-72934

CVE-2026-72934 describes a use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows Program Compatibility Assistant Service that allows an authenticated local attacker to escalate their privileges. Detection efforts should focus on monitoring for abnormal process execution or service interaction related to the Program Compatibility Assistant service (pcalua.exe or related components) that might indicate exploitation attempts.

Affected products:
- Windows Program Compatibility Assistant Service

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-72934

Affected products:
- Windows Audio Service

## CVE-2026-83635

An out-of-bounds read vulnerability exists in the Microsoft DNS Server component, which can be leveraged by a remote unauthorized attacker to cause a denial-of-service condition over a network.

## CVE-2026-83726

A use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows DWM Core Library allows a locally authenticated attacker to escalate privileges. The vulnerability exists due to improper memory management, which can be leveraged to achieve higher-level access on the system.

CVE-2026-83842 is a local privilege escalation vulnerability in the Windows TCP/IP stack caused by a double free condition. An attacker with local authorization can exploit this flaw to execute code with elevated privileges on the affected system.

Affected products:
- Windows

## CVE-2026-83843

CVE-2026-83843 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows Internet Key Exchange (IKE) extension, enabling an unauthenticated, remote attacker to trigger a denial of service condition on affected Windows systems by sending specially crafted network packets.

Affected products:
- Windows Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Extension

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-83843

## CVE-2026-83844

CVE-2026-83844 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows Paint application that can be exploited by a remote attacker to achieve code execution. Detection efforts should focus on anomalous network traffic or unusual process spawning behavior initiated by the Paint application.

Affected products:
- Paint

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-83844

## CVE-2026-83849

CVE-2026-83849 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Windows Hello that allows an authorized local attacker to perform information disclosure. Detection engineers should monitor for unauthorized access attempts to biometric data processing or sensitive system memory areas associated with the Windows Hello authentication subsystem.

Affected products:
- Windows Hello

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-83849

Affected products:
- Microsoft Account

## CVE-2026-83846

A use-after-free vulnerability exists in the Connected Devices Platform Service (Cdpsvc) on Windows, which can be exploited by an authorized local attacker to elevate privileges.

## CVE-2026-83855

CVE-2026-83855 is a denial-of-service vulnerability in the Windows WLAN Service caused by an integer underflow flaw. This vulnerability allows an unauthorized remote attacker to disrupt WLAN functionality by triggering a wraparound condition in the service, leading to a crash or service unavailability.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-83855

## CVE-2026-83865

CVE-2026-83865 identifies a relative path traversal vulnerability in the Windows Internet (wininet.dll) component. This flaw allows an authorized local attacker to perform file tampering, potentially leading to unauthorized modification of system files or security bypasses.

## CVE-2026-83875

CVE-2026-83875 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows HID Parser Library. An authorized local attacker can exploit this flaw to read sensitive information from the memory space, leading to unauthorized information disclosure.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-83875

CVE-2026-83893 is an information disclosure vulnerability in the Windows Clipboard User Service. An authorized attacker with local access can exploit this flaw to read sensitive system information, potentially leading to the exposure of data to unauthorized control spheres.

## CVE-2026-70163

CVE-2026-70163 describes a denial-of-service vulnerability in Microsoft's implementation of OpenSSH for Windows. The flaw stems from improper resource allocation management, specifically a lack of limits or throttling, which allows an unauthorized remote attacker to consume system resources and disrupt service availability.

Affected products:
- OpenSSH for Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70163

- Windows Shell

- Windows

## CVE-2026-70286

## CVE-2026-84009

A time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability exists in the Windows Projected File System, which could allow a locally authenticated attacker to perform file tampering. Successful exploitation requires an attacker to win a race condition during file access operations.

Affected products:
- Windows Projected File System

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-84009

- Remote Desktop Gateway Service

## CVE-2026-84012

CVE-2026-84012 is a remote code execution vulnerability in the Windows Remote Desktop Gateway Service caused by a double-free memory management error. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this flaw by sending specifically crafted network requests to the target service, potentially leading to full system compromise.

Affected products:
- Remote Desktop Gateway Service

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-84012

## CVE-2026-84011

CVE-2026-84011 describes a security feature bypass vulnerability in the Windows SMB Client caused by incorrect authorization. The vulnerability can be exploited locally by an authorized attacker to circumvent security controls.

Affected products:
- Windows SMB Client

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-84011

## CVE-2026-84013

CVE-2026-84013 is a local privilege escalation vulnerability in the Windows Telephony Server component caused by a use-after-free defect. An authorized attacker can exploit this flaw to execute code with elevated privileges on the target system.

Affected products:
- Windows Telephony Server

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-84013

## CVE-2026-84014

CVE-2026-84014 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows Device Association Service that enables an authorized local attacker to elevate their privileges to a higher integrity level.

Affected products:
- Windows

- Windows Performance Monitor

## CVE-2026-85353

CVE-2026-85353 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows Print Spooler Components that permits an unauthorized, unauthenticated attacker to remotely access sensitive information. Detection efforts should focus on monitoring anomalous network traffic directed toward the Print Spooler service (spoolsv.exe) and auditing print service logs for unexpected access patterns.

Affected products:
- Windows Print Spooler Components

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-85353

- Graphics Component

## CVE-2026-85376

## CVE-2026-85798

CVE-2026-85798 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows Distributed File System (DFS) that allows an authorized attacker to achieve remote code execution over a network. Detection engineers should monitor for anomalous DFS traffic or service crashes indicative of memory corruption attempts.

Affected products:
- Windows Distributed File System

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-85798

## CVE-2026-85816

CVE-2026-85816 describes an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows Wi-Fi Driver that allows an authorized attacker on an adjacent network to read sensitive memory information. Detection engineers should monitor for abnormal activity or errors related to Wi-Fi driver communication and stack memory operations.

Affected products:
- Windows

A use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows Universal Disk Format File System Driver (UDFS) allows a locally authenticated attacker to achieve privilege escalation by exploiting the driver's memory management errors.

Affected products:
- Windows Universal Disk Format File System Driver

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-85820

## CVE-2026-85821

The Windows Universal Disk Format File System Driver (UDFS) contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that allows an authenticated, local attacker to perform unauthorized information disclosure. This vulnerability originates from improper bounds checking within the file system driver, which could be leveraged to gain access to sensitive kernel-level memory information.

Affected products:
- Windows Universal Disk Format File System Driver

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-85821

## CVE-2026-85824

A use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows Composite Image File System allows a locally authenticated attacker to elevate their privileges to a higher integrity level. Detection engineers should monitor for unauthorized exploitation of filesystem drivers or unusual process behavior originating from low-integrity contexts interacting with system drivers.

Affected products:
- Windows Composite Image File System

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-85824

## CVE-2026-85852

CVE-2026-85852 describes an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) that enables an authorized local attacker to perform information disclosure. Detection engineers should monitor for unauthorized or unusual WMI queries or access patterns originating from low-privileged local accounts that may attempt to read restricted memory space.

Affected products:
- Windows Management Instrumentation

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-85852

## CVE-2026-85855

CVE-2026-85855 is a use-after-free vulnerability within the Windows DWM (Desktop Window Manager) Core Library. The vulnerability enables a locally authenticated attacker to achieve privilege escalation by exploiting memory corruption during window management operations.

Affected products:
- Windows DWM Core Library

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-85855

## CVE-2026-85856

CVE-2026-85856 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows Internet Connection Sharing (ICS) service that can be exploited by an authorized attacker on an adjacent network to achieve remote code execution.

Affected products:
- Internet Connection Sharing

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-85856

## CVE-2026-85857

CVE-2026-85857 is an information disclosure vulnerability in Windows Kernel-Mode Drivers, where sensitive information is incorrectly inserted into log files. This flaw allows a local, authorized attacker to gain unauthorized access to protected data.

Affected products:
- Windows Kernel-Mode Drivers

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-85857

## CVE-2026-85860

CVE-2026-85860 is a use-after-free vulnerability within the Windows Message Queuing Queue Manager component that enables a locally authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. Detection engineers should monitor for anomalous behavior or unexpected process termination associated with the Message Queuing service.

Affected products:
- Windows Message Queuing

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-85860

## CVE-2026-85858

CVE-2026-85858 describes an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows Win32 Kernel Subsystem. This flaw allows a locally authenticated attacker to elevate their privileges to a higher level of access on the system.

Affected products:
- Windows Win32 Kernel Subsystem

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-85858

## CVE-2026-85859

A null pointer dereference vulnerability exists in the Windows Message Queuing Queue Manager component. An authorized attacker can exploit this flaw over a network to trigger a denial of service condition by sending specifically crafted requests that lead to a system crash.

Affected products:
- Windows Message Queuing

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-85859

- Windows Clipboard User Service

## CVE-2026-70210

CVE-2026-70210 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Windows OLE DB that enables a remote, unauthorized attacker to execute code with elevated privileges on the target system.

Affected products:
- Windows Cloud Files Mini Filter Driver

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-88107

## CVE-2026-88132

CVE-2026-88132 is an information disclosure vulnerability in Microsoft Azure Key Vault caused by an origin validation error. The flaw enables an unauthorized remote attacker to access sensitive information by exploiting the lack of proper validation on network requests.

Affected products:
- Azure Key Vault

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-88132

## CVE-2026-88136

CVE-2026-88136 describes a remote code execution vulnerability in the Web Distributed Authoring and Versioning (WebDAV) component of Windows. The vulnerability stems from improper path equivalence resolution, allowing an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code over the network.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-88136

- Windows Key Storage Provider

- Windows

- Windows

- Windows

Affected products:
- Windows Push Notifications

- Windows

## CVE-2026-70075

A time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition exists in Windows Virtualization-Based Security (VBS) Enclave, which allows a local authorized attacker to bypass security features. This vulnerability is related to improper validation of state during concurrent operations within the enclave environment.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70075

CVE-2026-70288 describes a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition within the Windows Win32 Kernel Subsystem. This vulnerability allows an authenticated local attacker to perform an information disclosure attack by exploiting the race condition.

- Windows

- Windows

CVE-2026-70294 describes an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows Win32 Kernel Subsystem. This flaw allows an authorized local attacker to bypass security measures to disclose sensitive information from the kernel memory space.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70294

## CVE-2026-70295

CVE-2026-70295 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows Win32 Kernel Subsystem (win32k.sys). The flaw allows an authenticated local attacker to bypass memory protections and disclose sensitive kernel information, which could potentially be leveraged to facilitate further exploitation of the operating system.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70295

- Windows Credential Manager

- Excel

## CVE-2026-83747

CVE-2026-83747 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows Error Reporting component. The vulnerability allows a locally authenticated attacker to read sensitive memory contents, potentially leading to information disclosure.

Affected products:
- Windows Error Reporting

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-83747

## CVE-2026-83750

A time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability in Windows Error Reporting (WER) allows a locally authenticated attacker to escalate privileges. Successful exploitation requires the attacker to win a race condition to manipulate file operations performed by the service.

Affected products:
- Windows Error Reporting

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-83750

Affected products:
- Windows MIDI Service Module
